# Phase Two — Architecture and Evidence Map

The Awtsmoos gives form to possibility through vessels that preserve the light;
Awtsmoos.com must become more capable by making each boundary clearer, smaller, safer, and right.

## Observed project regions

The `geelooy` root currently exposes public and internal families including `apps`, `games`, `api`, `docs`, `shared`, `style`, `css`, editors, social surfaces, drive, OS, media, auth, and product-specific routes. Previous same-day evidence confirms catalog work already exists and warns against treating every filesystem directory as a public product.

## Candidate architectural layers to inspect before source writes

### Public discovery layer

- `geelooy/apps/index.html`
- `geelooy/apps/**` catalog/data/render modules
- `geelooy/games/index.html`
- `geelooy/games/scripts/**` catalog/data/render modules

Goal: ensure every real product is discoverable once, every action is truthful, and catalog UI remains clean and retractable.

### Shared UI layer

- `geelooy/shared/**`
- `geelooy/style/**`
- `geelooy/css/**`
- local styles within high-risk product folders

Goal: discover whether there is already a scoped design-token/component system. Reuse compatible foundations; do not add a second global styling universe.

### Agent/API layer

- `geelooy/api/**`
- `geelooy/.well-known/**`
- `geelooy/docs/**`
- `geelooy/DOCUMENTATION.md`
- any manifests describing tunnel/agent/auth capabilities

Goal: one data-backed capability model that can power machine discovery, human docs, examples, and install/bootstrap flows without duplicated truth.

### 2D/scene layer

- search `geelooy/**` for `cartoon`, `scene`, `canvas`, `svg`, `animation`, `timeline`, `merkava`, `character`, `sprite`, and related APIs
- inspect `geelooy/.ai-thoughts/2026-08-25-merkava-flagship-revelation/**`

Goal: extend the real existing rendering system instead of inventing a disconnected cartoon framework.

### High-risk UI families from previous mission

- Rebbe overlays
- Universal Chat
- DB Explorer
- Code menus
- Drive site-builder dock
- CSV tools
- Lyric Sync
- Archive Uploader
- game HUD/control families

Goal: runtime evidence first, then page-local rewrites only where measured defects exist.

## Candidate inheritance/data model

`KeliContract` — bounded interface for data validation and lifecycle.

`SefirahRegistry` extends `KeliContract` — immutable capability/product records with validation and normalization.

`MerkavaSurface` extends `KeliContract` — page/component lifecycle for a scoped DOM root and local state.

`MerkavaScene` extends `KeliContract` — 2D scene data, layout constraints, timeline, and adapter selection if a real scene engine exists.

Inheritance is permitted only if inspection proves shared behavior. Otherwise composition wins.

## CSS localization contract

1. Every new stylesheet owns exactly one surface/component family.
2. Every selector begins beneath a unique scope such as `[data-awtsmoos-surface="..."]` or a unique component root.
3. No new global reset.
4. No new generic utility class names.
5. Local CSS custom properties live on the scope root.
6. Nested child component style modules use their own namespace when independently reusable.
7. `@import` is explicit from the page/component stylesheet; no hidden global injection.
8. Overlay components create deliberate local stacking contexts and documented z-index tiers.
9. Motion is transform/opacity-first and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
10. Interaction selectors cover hover-capable pointers separately from active/focus-visible state.

## JavaScript contract

1. Every touched file is read completely and rewritten completely.
2. Human-authored source remains small enough to understand in one screen-sized mental model; responsibilities split before growth.
3. Tabs for indentation.
4. JSDoc for every exported class/function and all non-obvious internal functions.
5. Public API names remain boringly predictable even when internal domain classes use meaningful Torah/Kabbalah metaphors.
6. Data structures own variation; branching logic should not become the catalog.
7. Errors are structured and observable.
8. Async work is abortable when user navigation can make it stale.
9. DOM querying is rooted to the component surface.
10. No mutation of unrelated global styles/state.

## Verification graph

Source read -> architecture trace -> full-file rewrite -> syntax/static validation -> local unit/schema check -> runtime page probe -> mobile overflow/focus/state probe -> readback -> planned/actual delta -> second pass if needed.

## Current unknowns to resolve before final implementation plan

- Which shared style primitives already exist and are actively imported?
- Which API manifest is canonical today?
- Whether Party catalog delta was already implemented.
- Which files are over the modular limit and must not be extended.
- What current 2D/cartoon/scene engine already exists.
- Which public pages are currently failing mobile containment rather than merely looking old.
- Which docs are generated vs manually maintained.
- Which tests already cover catalogs, agents, docs, and rendering.
